name: Spatial resolution & scale-consistency
description: How well dataset native resolutions match the spatial scale required by the use case (field/parcel, municipality, regional) and whether aggregation/disaggregation steps are needed.
why_it_matters: Mismatch in spatial scale introduces aggregation error, ecological fallacy, or smoothing of signals critical for local decisions (e.g., parcel-level erosion vs. county-level insurance).

name: Temporal coverage & alignment
description: Extent and overlap of observational records (years, seasons) and the temporal granularity (daily, seasonal) relative to the use case.
why_it_matters: Insufficient overlap or coarse temporal resolution limits trend detection, calibration validity, and event-based nowcasting.

name: Variable representativeness & relevancy
description: Whether the dataset provides the actual variables required (precipitation, soil moisture, PAW, phenology, NDVI) in appropriate form and quality.
why_it_matters: Using proxies or inadequate variables reduces the ability to detect causal relationships or to drive models accurately.

name: Uncertainty quantification & propagation
description: Availability and use of uncertainty estimates (e.g., ensemble spread, confidence intervals, RMSE) and whether those uncertainties are propagated into derived outputs/decisions.
why_it_matters: Decision-support and risk products require quantified uncertainty to avoid overconfident actions and to set premiums/thresholds appropriately.

name: Validation & ground truth availability
description: Presence, representativeness and independence of ground truth data for model training, calibration and validation.
why_it_matters: Robust validation ensures transferability and trustworthiness of models across space/time and for operational use.

name: Aggregation, preprocessing & reproducibility
description: Clarity and reproducibility of aggregation/processing steps (e.g., weighted averaging, spin-up, masking), and whether public workflows allow replication.
why_it_matters: Opaque processing prevents independent verification and obstructs integration across studies and operational systems.

name: Accessibility & public-data usage
description: Whether the dataset is publicly available, documented, and easy to reuse (licensing, formats, coverage).
why_it_matters: Public, well-documented data enable reproducible science, multi-study integration, and fair operational deployment (insurance, monitoring).

name: Operational suitability (latency & update cadence)
description: Whether the data support real-time or near-real-time applications (low latency, frequent updates) vs retrospective analyses.
why_it_matters: Nowcasting, monitoring and insurance require timely inputs; datasets optimized for retrospective analysis may be unsuitable operationally.
